grid.objective: next-season projection loss on the tuning seasons

calibration.rule: D19: sd x sqrt(c), c the mean squared standardised error of the chosen cell's tuning forecasts; a tuning block uses the earlier tuning seasons, later blocks all of them

gate.rule: EuroLeague validation next-season projection loss: the chosen variant below marcel's and same_as_last's (point rule), and its pooled tuning + validation 80% interval coverage inside the band for every stat; player-cluster bootstrap 95% CIs of the loss differences reported
